result.summary: The intersection includes basic pedestrian infrastructure such as signalization and tactile warning pads, but safety is significantly compromised by a large visual obstruction at the corner. The surrounding environment is impacted by construction, resulting in uneven pavement and debris near the walkway.

hazards.name: Corner Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: A small utility or retail shed is positioned directly at the corner, blocking sightlines between pedestrians and approaching or turning vehicles.

hazards.name: Uneven Pavement
hazards.description: The sidewalk surface is cracked and uneven, creating potential trip hazards for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Construction Encroachment
hazards.description: Fencing and debris from the adjacent construction site narrow the pedestrian path and create a cluttered environment.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove or relocate the corner structure to ensure clear sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and improve the visibility of pedestrians waiting to cross.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Repair and resurface the sidewalk to eliminate trip hazards and ensure ADA compliance.

result.summary: The intersection features a marked high-visibility crosswalk and curb ramps with tactile warning pads. However, the wide roadway and multiple travel lanes increase pedestrian exposure time to vehicular traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the roadway requires pedestrians to spend a significant amount of time exposed to traffic.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked crosswalks, sidewalks, and dedicated pedestrian signals. However, the wide crossing distance and lack of physical traffic calming or refuge islands increase pedestrian exposure to vehicular traffic.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: The wide intersection increases the time pedestrians are exposed to traffic without a median refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the center of the frame

hazards.name: Pavement degradation
hazards.description: Visible cracking and wear in the asphalt surface within the intersection area.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sight lines.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade standard parallel line markings to continental or ladder style markings for better visibility.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic receives a green light.

result.summary: The environment features a two-lane street with a marked crosswalk on one side and a bike lane on the other. However, pedestrian safety is compromised by a lack of sidewalk on the right side, poor pavement quality, and significant visual obstructions from a large bus parked near the crossing.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: A large transit bus is parked immediately adjacent to the crosswalk, completely blocking sightlines between pedestrians and oncoming traffic.

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalk
hazards.description: The right side of the street lacks a paved sidewalk, forcing pedestrians to walk in the bike lane or roadway edge near construction fencing.

hazards.name: Pavement Degradation
hazards.description: Significant cracking and uneven patching in the roadway and near the crosswalk area create potential trip hazards.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Replace the faded parallel line markings with high-visibility continental or ladder-style markings to increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the crossing to shorten the crossing distance and prevent vehicles from parking too close to the crosswalk, improving sightlines.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion
interventions.description: Construct a continuous paved sidewalk on the right side of the street to provide a safe, separated space for pedestrians.
